name: Desperate Resuscitation
text:
Requirements You are holding a Healer's Toolkit or are wearing one and have a free hand; the target's body is mostly intact; the target was not killed by a death effect.

---
You can use your training in combat medicine to revive the recently deceased. Attempt a DC 40 Medicine check check to revive a dead creature that has been dead for no more than 3 rounds. If you succeed, the target returns to life with the effects of Raise Dead, except it still has the wounded condition it had before dying, increased by 1 (or Wounded 1 if it wasn't wounded before dying). Whether you succeed or fail, the target is temporarily immune to Desperate Resuscitation for 1 day.
